findings.description: Direct inspection of the fresh V133 front, back, side, three-quarter and neutral images shows a smooth flared shell with jagged panel ridges, not a clearly readable repeated pleat pattern. Required action: revise sewn-panel geometry so folds read consistently in all required views.

Fresh V133 front and side views retain a projecting waist-level shelf at the skirt attachment; rear views also show uneven overlap. Required action: remove the shelf and make the upper skirt edge follow the torso/waist contour continuously.

Fresh V133 crouch and sit images show exposed shorts/thigh regions and bunching or dangling skirt panels; prone remains a broad rigid-looking mass. Patchy torso/back interference is also visible. Required action: correct clearance and deformation at sewn-panel level, then regenerate and inspect all eleven views.

nextAction: Keep REJECT. V133 improves mesh robustness enough to reach rendering, but the fresh appearance review still fails pleat readability, waist attachment and pose deformation. Fit and deform weights also remain rejected by the measured geometry audit. Do not release; revise the sewn-panel construction before another prototype review.
